title: Energy And The Jensen Tail Risk
gist: Louis-Vincent Gave notes that energy stocks, the best-performing sector in the MSCI World and S&P 500 over five years, have pulled back alongside a ~20% oil price drop from pre-midterm highs, driven by reduced Iran-war odds, Ukraine-truce hopes and talk of a US-Russia-China 'new Yalta' at Apec in Shenzhen — hopes he treats with evident irony. (Teaser only; the 'Jensen tail risk' argument is paywalled.)
